inlines.v: AS'YMPTOTE, noun [Gr. priv. with, and to fall; not meeting or coinciding.] A line which approaches nearer and nearer to some curve, but though infinitely extended, would never meet it. This may be conceived as a tangent to a curve at an infinite distance.
